Find value bets across all matches for 1X2 market

Source: R/kelly.R
find_value_bets.Rd

Scans model predictions against devigged odds to find bets where the model edge exceeds the minimum threshold.

Usage

find_value_bets(
  preds,
  devigged,
  odds,
  min_edge = 0.03,
  min_odds = 1.5,
  max_odds = 10
)

Arguments

preds

A tibble with match_id, pred_h, pred_d, pred_a.

devigged

A tibble with match_id, fair_h, fair_d, fair_a.

odds

A tibble with match_id, psh, psd, psa (raw Pinnacle decimal odds).

min_edge

Numeric. Minimum edge (default 0.03).

min_odds

Numeric. Minimum odds (default 1.50).

max_odds

Numeric. Maximum odds (default 10.0).

Value

A tibble of value bets with columns: match_id, outcome, model_prob, market_prob, decimal_odds, edge, kelly_stake.
